notes.title: Lesson Learned full version premiere
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836807/8d0c8baf0b47dc96251db2a04ee85d60bfb0fec4.png[/img]

It’s me, Amelia! The day we've all been waiting for has arrived. What we learned together in the prologue, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url] will be tested today. Let's start a historical eras exam. 

[h3]The full version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url] is now available on [b]Steam[/b] with a [b]-25%[/b] discount and on Xbox! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/

My best friend Frank fell asleep in history class and found himself in a bizarre dream world. He often failed to pay attention in school, but he had never yet had to defend himself from an attack by Roman legionaries because of it! 

To get out, you'll have to work together to guide our base, Gervase, through prehistory, antiquity and even the French Revolutionary era. See for yourself who you will have to face on various levels:

[previewyoutube=0trRota7UbI;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Frank and help him find the rest of his classmates. A journey through historical eras is a real group project, so cooperation will be important. You, too, can invite your friends and go through the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url] campaign in split-screen [i]cooperative mode[/i].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]Lesson Learned[/b][/url], is a tower defense game. You will obtain different types of towers, learn how to distribute tasks, and fend off the attacks of various enemies. Everyone has their own weaknesses, for example Mikey can’t resist donuts, and our enemies will be defeated by fire or spikes. If you want to practice the game's mechanics, join me in playing the free prologue, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url], which is now available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/

Frank is waiting for our help already on the first level, so let's get started! If you have any questions, drop by the class [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url].

Good luck!
Amelia & Gaming Factory

notes.title: Lesson 1 - Elizabeth Bathory
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

I never liked history lessons. Frank was always scribbling in his notebook, Mickey was playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/][b]demo Lesson Learned[/b][/url], others were throwing paper balls at each other and I was falling asleep on the bench. Recently, however, we were discussing my favorite era, the Renaissance, and one character stood out in particular. The great (literally) Countess Elizabeth Bathory - ah, what a character she was... Take notes, because what I tell you today will certainly come in handy on our sleepy trip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836807/07a4988b5c029eaf68f1850506b0914a7b2ee8d8.jpg[/img]
[h2]The era of creativity[/h2]
But before I introduce you to this legendary figure of the Countess, a few words about the era itself. The Renaissance was an age of great inventions and famous names like Leonardo Da Vinci - no, he's not the actor who starred in Titanic. I've heard Frank talk about this era before, and if you haven't had a chance to listen, you can check out his [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1563870/view/3705938855384379276]old notes[/url]. 

[h2]The Bloody Countess[/h2]
Don't get me wrong. Many school textbooks portray her as a woman of incredible beauty, but after meeting her for the first time, I can say she resembles a wet chicken at best. 

A Hungarian aristocrat, Elizabeth Bathory was not nicknamed the Bloody Countess for nothing. She is said to have taken rejuvenating baths in the blood of young girls. Sometimes I get the impression that our friend Barbara uses them too... I shudder at the thought. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836807/eaa746e40c210aeabf468815b141b18ce76a7222.png[/img]
Prepare well for the defense of our base, for the Countess has her faithful servants who will rush to the attack at the mere nod of her great scepter. Invite your friends to join you, and we will certainly have a better chance in this duel. 

The free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/][b]Prologue to Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth[/b][/url] is coming soon to PC and consoles, so we've got some time to work out the best strategies. Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/]wishlist[/url] on Steam so you don't miss out on any news, and if you'd like to chat with us, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url] class!

Amelka and the Gaming Factory[/i].

[previewyoutube=USmwW8KCD0w;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Let's defend the base![/h2]
This dream world is a place full of strange and twisted creatures (some of which remind me of Michas in appearance), so you'd better get ready for the next clash. Gather resources such as wood and stone to build and improve our defensive towers. They are the key to our success and will allow us to repel even the strongest units. We will not allow our base to be destroyed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44836807/61345c4e6cae832e03b71f6ccee8a5d0558bedbd.png[/img]

We all know that there is strength in numbers! With the help of our friends, even the fiercest of enemies will be no match for us. Invite your companions to play in split-screen cooperative mode, sharing tasks, strategizing, and facing the oncoming hordes together. Let's defeat the sinister Elizabeth Batory!
